obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional mathematical specification; finite tests only
obernants.assumptions: Validated size/domain and successful standard allocations
obernants.domain: Declared bounded public API and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, validation and named assertions
obernants.operator: For accepted affine solution (v,N), Av!=b or any column vector u with Au!=0 is excluded; missing nullspace dimension n-rank(A) is excluded. None is excluded for a consistent system.

obernants.operator: Observed (v,N) admits all matrices and rhs whose deterministic RREF selection yields that affine basis; multiplying a row and its rhs by nonzero c preserves the result. None has many inconsistent preimages, e.g. 0*x=1 and 0*x=2.

obernants.operator: Columns ascend, first available nonzero row chosen. Pivot row normalized; eliminate every other row. Free columns ascend, set own free coordinate1 and others0, yielding a deterministic basis.

obernants.operator: All solutions are particular+sum t_i nullspace[i]. Empty equation set yields zero particular and identity basis; zero variables returns empty solution iff every rhs is zero.
